name: Cassian Andor's blaster
description: Cassian Andor's blaster was a BlasTech A280-CFE convertible heavy blaster pistol used by Captain Cassian Andor. The blaster's primary function is that of a hand-held sidearm, which he carried in a thigh holster, but it could also accept barrel and stock attachments to convert it into a sniper rifle or an assault rifle.

data.name: Cassian Andor's blaster
data.destroyed: 1 BBY, during the Battle of Scarif
